user.title: Set up Notification Center
user.description: Creates five sensors: messages, notifications, updates, repairs and profiles. No credentials are needed, only one instance can be set up. Recipient profiles, silent mode and delivery are set afterwards under “Configure”.

init.title: Notification Center {version}
init.description:
Version {version}. {update_info}

A profile bundles a name and a notification target. When you switch phones, only the profile's target changes - cards and automations stay untouched.

add_recipient.title: Add profile
add_recipient.description: The target is a service of the “notify” domain, e.g. mobile_app_pixel_9 (phone) or the name of your email service.

settings.title: Silent mode and history
settings.description: In silent mode no push messages are sent; messages stay visible in the card and widget. Critical messages can bypass it.

delivery.title: Delivery by urgency
delivery.description: Choose which profiles receive a push message for each urgency. Without a choice, critical messages and warnings are pushed to all phone profiles.

error.name_exists: A profile with this name already exists.

send.name: Send message
send.description: Sends a message to a recipient profile. Switching phones only needs a change to the profile.

recipient.name: Recipient
recipient.description: Name or ID of a recipient profile.

urgency.name: Urgency
urgency.description: Normal, high or urgent. “Urgent” bypasses silent mode on phones.

unknown_recipient.message: The recipient profile “{recipient}” does not exist. Add profiles under Settings → Devices & services → Notification Center → Configure.
